elements_selected.content:
Create src/search_index.rs with the Tantivy index management layer. This module encapsulates all Tantivy interaction:

Schema: Three fields per document:
  - page_name: STRING (stored, indexed for filtering)
  - path: STRING (stored, not indexed)
  - body: TEXT (indexed for full-text search, stored)

Tokenization: Tantivy's default tokenizer (lowercase, split on whitespace/punctuation).

Index location: .zetl/search/ directory.

Public API:
  - SearchIndex::build(vault_root, files: &[ParsedFile]) -> Result<SearchIndex>
    Creates/opens .zetl/search/, iterates files, extracts body text using scanner::body_text_ranges(), creates one Tantivy document per file. Clears and rebuilds the full index (incremental update handled at the caller level via cache).
  - SearchIndex::open(vault_root) -> Result<Option<SearchIndex>>
    Opens an existing index from .zetl/search/. Returns None if directory doesn't exist.
  - SearchIndex::query(query_str, limit) -> Result<Vec<SearchHit>>
    Parses query with QueryParser against the body field, executes with TopDocs collector, returns Vec of (page_name, path, score) tuples.
  - SearchIndex::reader() -> Result<IndexReader>
    For serve mode: returns a reader that can be held across requests.

SearchHit struct: { page_name: String, path: String, score: f64 }

Body text extraction: For each file, concatenate the byte ranges from body_text_ranges() into a single string. This reuses the same exclusion logic as SPEC-002 (no frontmatter, code blocks, inline code, HTML comments). Import body_text_ranges from scanner.rs.

Error handling: Return anyhow::Result with context about which file or query failed.

REQ-013-001, ADR-013-001.
